page_title: LAZ 2-2 NAP | Lazio v Napoli 15/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Adam Marusic (Lazio) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

90+3' Nice individual effort by Tijjani Noslin (Lazio). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the bottom right corner, but Alex Meret does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out. Lazio earn a corner.
90+1' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Wonderful movement by Lazio. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
87' 2 - 2 Boulaye Dia (Lazio) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
85' Substitution. Rafa Marin (Napoli) in, Pasquale Mazzocchi out.
84' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
82' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) replaces Gustav Isaksen.
82' We are about to witness a substitution. Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) is replacing Nuno Tavares.
82' Mario Gila (Lazio) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
79' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Massa had an easy-decision to make.
78' Juan Jesus (Napoli) lunges into his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
77' The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick. Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
76' The referee blows his whistle as Scott McTominay (Napoli) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to Lazio in a dangerous position.
75' Lazio are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball is out of play. Lazio will take a throw-in.
74' It's time for a substitution. Boulaye Dia (Lazio) comes on in place of Pedro.
73' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
72' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing. The ball is out of play and Lazio manage to earn a corner.
69' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.

69' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. Napoli force a corner. They send men into the box.
68' The goal by Lazio is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
67' Wait! Referee Davide Massa immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
64' 1 - 2 This is definitely not what Adam Marusic (Lazio) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 1:2.

64' Napoli slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
63' Pedro (Lazio) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
62' The game has come to an end for Alessandro Buongiorno. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Matteo Politano (Napoli).

61' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lazio are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
59' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
58' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but Ivan Provedel comes off his line to gather the ball.
56' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) makes a strong challenge and Davide Massa blows for a foul.
55' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.

54' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Napoli are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

52' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Ivan Provedel makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
51' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
50' Napoli are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
48' The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick. Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
46' Wonderful movement by Lazio. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
46' Davide Massa blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' A quickly taken corner by Lazio.
45+1' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
44' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Davide Massa signals. Lazio have a free kick.

41' Napoli slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
39' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

39' A sweet pass finds Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Alex Meret is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The referee signals a corner kick to Lazio.
38' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
37' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
35' What was Frank Anguissa (Napoli) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

34' Mario Gila (Lazio) brings his opponent down. Davide Massa has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Napoli, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
32' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
31' Napoli are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
29' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
27' That's the end of the game for Taty Castellanos, who is replaced by Tijjani Noslin (Lazio).
24' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. The ball is behind the touchline and Napoli will take a throw-in.
22' Napoli are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.

20' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
18' Lazio are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lazio.
16' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the left post by a whisker. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.

13' 1 - 1 Goal! Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Romelu Lukaku inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:1.
11' Lazio seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
9' Napoli show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.

6' 1 - 0 Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the top left corner. He makes it 1:0 with this magnificent strike.
5' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

5' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Alex Meret pulls off a great save to stop his attempt towards the top right corner. Lazio get a corner.
4' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Lazio have a free kick from a promising distance.
3' Lazio are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Napoli will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Davide Massa.
